calls.head: The Red Wings’ power play has a target
calls.body: The Red Wings’ power play is one of the league’s best, and the Blue Jackets’ kill is near the bottom. The Blue Jackets need to stay out of the box.

calls.head: The Blue Jackets’ defense joins the attack, the Red Wings’ stays home
calls.body: On shots from defensemen, Columbus is one of the league’s best, but Detroit is one of the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Watch the Blue Jackets’ defensemen jump into the play.

DET.head: We had this close to even (48% for Detroit), and they came through.

surprises.head: John Gibson stole one with a shutout
surprises.body: Gibson stopped all 18 shots, worth 3.2 expected goals. That is more than Detroit’s winning margin. Starting goalies have a night this good about once every 100 starts. Most starters don’t get one a season.

story.head: Gibson slams the door on the Blue Jackets
paras: J.T. Compher opened the scoring for the Red Wings midway through the first, and Alex DeBrincat made it 2-0 early in the third. Detroit had a goal taken off for offside with just seven seconds left, but it didn’t cost them in the end.

The Blue Jackets had the better of the chances. Replay those chances a hundred times and the Blue Jackets win about six in ten. John Gibson made the difference in net, stopping 18 of 18. The Jackets hit a post and the crossbar twice, and the bounces never came. Jet Greaves stopped 19 of 21 for the Blue Jackets. The Red Wings improved to 10-12-3, seventh in the Atlantic, while the Blue Jackets dropped to 9-14-1, seventh in the Metropolitan.

items.text: Alex DeBrincat has a point in all ten of his games against Columbus since 2023-24.
The Blue Jackets are winless in three (0-2-1).
Adam Fantilli’s seven-game point streak against Detroit ended.
Carter Mazur was in NHL.com’s projected lineup, but Mason Appleton played instead.
